Component: C#/WinRT runtime 2.2.0 (WinRT.Runtime.dll, built from microsoft/CsWinRT commit
8649ee3eeb2445ca2a36d80d878ef60b96a6c65d per its ProductVersion), installed with PixCap for Windows.
It reaches the app through the Windows SDK projection pack (see 30-windows-sdk-projection);
its upstream licence is MIT, reproduced here as well.
